summary.text: Amanda Easley is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 22B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Jason Monks.
A small business owner in the animal health industry, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities are affordability and strong public schools.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Easley earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Arlington, and her career experience includes work as a business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey she said she was born and raised in Texas, lived in Colorado for 10 years and moved to Idaho in 2018.
She said she began her career as a veterinary technician and now owns a consulting business serving animal health companies.

She also said she is a parent of a child in Idaho schools and the daughter of a public school teacher, and that she supports adequate funding for public education and opposes policies that divert public funds from neighborhood public schools.
